title: Endpoint-Stable Interval Inverse Inequalities for Multiscale Kernels with Positive Exponential Spectra
summary: Inverse inequalities are essential for controlling derivative growth and ensuring stable sampling in kernel approximation. Existing whole-space and single-scale estimates provide an established analytical basis, but their extension to multiscale analytic spaces on finite intervals requires uniform control of boundary effects and cross-scale cancellation. This paper establishes unweighted interval \(L^2\) inverse inequalities for spaces generated by primitives of kernels with positive exponential spectra.
